title: Pocketwire Personal Account Weekly Limit Increase Terms by Plan
content:
The terms on which a Pocketwire Personal Account may have its weekly send limit raised are set per plan.

| Plan | Limit increase available | Minimum account age at decision (calendar days) | Spacing between limit decisions (calendar days) | Largest single increase (percent of the current effective weekly limit) | Ceiling of an approved weekly limit (USD) | Decision target (business days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Pocketwire Lite | No | 30 | 90 | 0 | 299.99 | 5 |
| Pocketwire Core | Yes | 30 | 90 | 50 | 15000.00 | 5 |
| Pocketwire Plus | Yes | 30 | 60 | 50 | 20000.00 | 3 |
| Pocketwire Prime | Yes | 14 | 60 | 75 | 40000.00 | 3 |
| Pocketwire Onyx | Yes | 14 | 30 | 100 | 60000.00 | 2 |
| Pocketwire Summit | Yes | 0 | 30 | 100 | 100000.00 | 1 |

### Column meanings

- **Limit increase available** — whether the plan may request a weekly send limit increase.
- **Minimum account age** — the minimum calendar days between the account opened date and the limit decision.
- **Spacing** — the minimum calendar days between the previous limit decision date and a new limit decision.
- **Largest single increase** — the largest single increase over the current effective weekly send limit, as a percentage of that limit.
- **Ceiling** — the figure an approved weekly send limit may never exceed.
- **Decision target** — the service target for deciding a submitted limit increase request, in business days.

Pocketwire Lite cannot request an increase; its ceiling equals its weekly send limit of 299.99. On Pocketwire Summit there is no minimum account age (0 days).
